# Security Checklist: Opt-In Per-Request Credentials

**Purpose**: Review whether secret-handling and scope requirements are complete, unambiguous,
and consistent before implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on
feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review
artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality
criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for
requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for both a present credential set and an omitted
  set, not only for the happy path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the prohibition on writing values to logs, error strings, and metrics
  stated for success, unrelated failure, and rejection? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK003 Are out-of-scope boundaries documented for the process pool, router, instance
  cap, new message fields, new capability entries, and issue #195? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the requirement that values die with the call, rather than moving to the
  environment, a cache, or a file, written for overlapping calls as well as sequential
  ones? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "not an error" for a missing set distinguished from rejection of unusable
  material? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the numeric limits (16 names, 64-character names, 4096-character values,
  16384 total value characters) stated in the requirements rather than left as "small"?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "unsafe" name or value defined by a character and length rule a reviewer
  can apply without inventing one? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the acceptance note's meaning limited to opt-in, and not to "this process
  is shared" or "CORS credentials are enabled"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §US4]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Does the default in FR-001 stay aligned with spec 029's per-organization
  process and environment credentials, including when FR-012 adds a second call path?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK010 Does US2's "environment is not modified" match FR-005, with no requirement
  that the SDK rewrite the process environment for the duration of a call?
  [Consistency, Spec §US2, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK011 Do FR-007, FR-008, and FR-013 agree that the capability list is unchanged
  while the existing plugin-information notes still advertise opt-in? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the maintainer override in Clarifications agree with Assumptions, so
  the assessment is a rejected alternative rather than an open gate? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can SC-001 be judged from two calls on one process without referring to a
  host pool? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK014 Does SC-003 name the fixture value and require zero occurrences in logs,
  error strings, and metric labels? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-002 be judged by counting acceptance notes and environment entries,
  both of which are required to be zero? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK016 Does SC-006 state what a reviewer looks for (absence of pool, router, and
  cap) rather than a production memory target? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are primary, alternate (no credentials), and exception (unusable material)
  flows each given an acceptance scenario? [Coverage, Spec §US1, Spec §US2, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the recovery rule specified when material is unusable: fail with a fixed
  message and do not fall through to another tenant's environment credentials?
  [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are both the native call path and the web-compatible call path required to
  carry the same names and values, including the omitted-set case? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Spec §SC-005]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are empty sets, case-only duplicate names, caller mutation after attach, and
  a hand-written note that disagrees with opt-in each addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK021 Is overlapping use of two sets on one process distinguished from sequential
  calls? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK022 Is an unrelated call failure while values are attached required to keep
  those values out of SDK records? [Edge Case, Spec §US3]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 Is a performance expectation recorded for the common case where no
  credential material is attached, separate from the secret-redaction requirements?
  [Completeness, plan.md §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK024 Are browser cross-origin sends of these values excluded, rather than left
  as an implied default? [Coverage, Spec §Out of Scope, plan.md §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK025 Does the spec forbid new legacy PulumiCost-prefixed names without relying
  on a reader to remember the rename? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK026 Is the assumption that cloud files and binary blobs are out of scope stated
  next to the text-value limits? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK027 Is issue #195 named as a dependency that is explicitly not settled here?
  [Dependency, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the unsourced process-size figure excluded from the success criteria?
  [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §SC-006]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK029 Is there any remaining requirement that uses "secure", "appropriate", or
  "small" without a limit or a forbidden location? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK030 Does any requirement still conflict with spec 029 by making per-request
  credentials the default rather than an opt-in? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002]

## Notes

- Non-interactive defaults applied for this run: depth Standard, audience PR reviewer,
  focus secret handling and scope boundaries. The spec's clarifications already choose
  the scenario classes, so no further questions were left open.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is
  satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer
  evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify
  markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by
  `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
